title: Vehicle Accelerated Properties
description: Detects vehicles that exhibit sudden or abnormal acceleration within a defined surveillance zone. Captures vehicle view, zone information, and vehicle classification details. Use this event when queries involve rapid acceleration, aggressive driving behavior, or abnormal vehicle movement analysis.

vehicle_view.description: View or orientation of the detected vehicle (e.g., front, rear, side).

zoneid.description: Identifier of the zone where sudden acceleration was detected.

type.description: Category or classification of the detected vehicle (e.g., car, truck, bus, two-wheeler).
